text.tspan: the filter calls doFilter and returns without touching the SecurityContext
permitAll short-circuits here and the empty context is never challenged

svg.text: mint a UUID traceId and set the X-Trace-Id response header
shouldNotFilter returns false because /api/v1/news is not an auth endpoint
resolveToken checks the Authorization header then the JWT cookie
getSubject rejects the expired or tampered token
401 TOKEN_EXPIRED or 403 INVALID_TOKEN even though the endpoint is public
walk the rules until GET /api/v1/** matches permitAll
look up the khi cache key
SELECT news and its embedded ckb and kmr columns
store the DTO with a 10 minute TTL
